title: Resolve accepted Story 1.2 adversarial findings F1-F8
summary: Implement the accepted Story 1.2 transaction and recovery corrections F1-F8. F1 is safety-critical: journal destination strings are evidence only; recovery must resolve authoritative destinations through the bound declared component, validate agreement and containment, and fail closed on missing or contradictory authority. Add deterministic regressions for F1-F8, preserve managed-section mode and supported ownership metadata, implement reboot/PID-reuse-resistant lock ownership, and keep applied revision and journal authority truthful. Copy useful reviewer reproduction logic into repository tests; repository tests must not depend on temporary scratchpad paths.
